unittest: Fix race condition in input_pull_socket_unittest. Bind and listen the port before creating the plugin, to avoid the race condition that the plugin is created before the port is bound, and the input_pull_socket plugin would fail connect and sleep for 60 seconds, causing the test to time out. BUG=None TEST=make test many times, and see that flaky rate of input_pull_socket_unittest is reduced. Change-Id: I90d5d29ec909956bb171355ed01a214390b4773d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/805011 Commit-Ready: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Chun-Tsen Kuo <chuntsen@chromium.org>

net_utils: Fix FindUnusedPort. FindUnusedPort should not set SO_REUSEADDR, since the options means that this bind should still bind even if there's a previous one in TIME_WAIT state, so we may return a port with someone in TIME_WAIT state, but it's possible that the caller of FindUnusedPort doesn't set the option and fail the bind. This reduce input_pull_socket_unittest flakyness to less than 1%. BUG=None TEST=make test many times, and see that input_pull_socket_unittest is not flaky. CHROMIUM: ath10k: add a knob to toggle PS-POLL station kickout logic in FW Firmware notes down the last received frame from the station before it has gone into power save. If the STA wakes up and sends a PS-POLL frame (indicating it has exited from powersave) after 150secs,STA will be kicked out. This knob will toggle the PS-POLL station kickout logic in FW. You can enable the ps-poll kickout logic for a station as below: echo 0|1 > /sys/kernel/debug/ieee80211/phy0/netdev\:wlan-2400mhz/stations/{mac_address_of_station}/pspoll_sta_ko_enable Here 1 indicates enabling the PS-POLL station kickout logic and 0 indicates disabling the PS-POLL station kickout logic BUG=chrome-os-partner:62036 TEST= Connect a 2x2 client to the AP. Run traffic. After sometime, make sure the client has gone to power save and wakes up by sending PS-poll only after 150secs. You should see the PS-poll inactivity kickout. Using above debugfs knob toggle the pspoll station kickout in FW and test if the kickout is turned off or on appropriately Change-Id: I1dffb5f0a3b18035d630268cd31620856f5df84a Signed-off-by: Ashok Raj Nagarajan <arnagara@codeaurora.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/443211 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@google.com> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@google.com>
